intelligence.enrichment: In liquids, particles can move and change positions within a limited space while remaining close enough under attraction, so liquids have no fixed shape but have a fixed volume. limited particle movement with continuing attraction -> container shape but fixed amount of liquid The learner explains that liquid particles move and change positions within a limited space while attractions keep them close, so the liquid takes container shape but keeps its measured volume. A liquid changes both shape and volume whenever its container changes.
